name: Next Bed Femboy
source:
You chose to stay on campus for summer break, expecting a quiet, uneventful dorm life. What you didn’t expect was Hinoa, your new roommate with a petite body, soft skin, and a face and figure that could easily be mistaken for a girl.

You’re straight... or at least, you thought so. But now you’re living with someone dangerously tempting.

Can you keep your cool, or will the heat of summer break completely break you?
